title.text: lamina Paper — Edit session and organise (O01–O08)

o01.text:
O01 Edit session and history
Purpose: show that the document has unsaved changes and let people step back through them.
States: dirty ("4 unsaved changes", macOS title "Edited"), undo/redo enabled or disabled, History tab with current point and undone steps, undo toast, Partial/Skipped outcome toasts.
Todos: E1d

o02.text:
O02 Save, Save as, Download a copy
Purpose: save explicitly and say what a save does to signatures before it happens.
States: Save menu on an approval-signed file (incremental, optimised blocked); certified file with the constraint banner and the remove-signature confirm; file changed on disk while dirty; web without File System Access (Download).
Todos: E1e

o03.text:
O03 Close with unsaved changes
Purpose: never lose edits silently when a window or tab closes.
States: one document (Save / Don't save / Cancel), signed-file line, quit with several dirty documents (in the doc).
Todos: E2i

o04.text:
O04 Document info and XMP editor
Purpose: edit title, author, subject, keywords, dates, producer and creator, and any XMP property.
States: Description tab with PDF/A note and a pending removal; XMP tab with tree, custom PDF/A extension property; raw XML with a validation error (in the doc).
Todos: E1f, E3e

o05.text:
O05 Capability page
Purpose: show, per operation, what lamina reads, writes and round-trips in core, library, web and desktop.
States: filtered by group and surface, search, no matches (in the doc). Statuses shown are an illustration, not a release claim.
Todos: E1f

o06.text:
O06 Organise mode
Purpose: reorder, rotate, insert, duplicate, extract and delete pages in a grid, with keyboard and non-drag alternatives.
States: 2 pages selected with insertion bar (drag), page context menu, Move to page… dialog, delete refused on a page holding a signed signature.
Todos: E2h, E2b

o07.text:
O07 Insert pages and merge
Purpose: bring pages in from another PDF or images, and combine whole documents.
States: Insert from a PDF with page picker and position; Merge with ordered list and options; images tab, merge report (in the doc).
Todos: E2c, E2d, E3h

o08.text:
O08 Split document
Purpose: split into several files by page count, ranges or top-level bookmarks.
States: By bookmarks with a preview of the output files; by count and ranges, invalid range, done (in the doc).
Todos: E2d
